items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson I bought, and I just fell in love with that straight away

ctx.x: So did you have to stick your ear next to your record player?

I played the records when my parents were out. But I remember the first LP I had, they had these wonderful little ten inch LPs which were marvelous. Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson I bought, and I just fell in love with that straight away because that had not only the great jazz musicians on them but they had the songs. And I started getting really into these songs there, because you have these songs done in the jazz way by composers like Jerome Kern and Irving Berlin and Rogers and Hart, and you know, all the…
So how did you get from that step to the actual playing? Was it through sheet music?
